turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I was wondering if you could tell me a little bit about what brought you in to the Emergency Department today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so nice to meet you. I've been having this pain right in my abdomen. It's kind of like in the upper right area.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so uh, when, where is this painting located exactly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's just in the upper right corner of my abdomen, right below where the lungs are, and it, yeah, it's just I have this severe pain that's going on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long is it been going on for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's been going on for the last few days and it got worse today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long is it been since it's like got got worse, has this been a few hours or or how long is that been?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I would say it got worse, just three or four hours ago before I came to the Emergency Department.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and does the pain radiate anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, it stays right in the in the spot that I told you right in the right upper corner.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when did the pain start? Or if you could tell me what were you doing right prior to the pain starting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I think it started after just three days ago after I had a meal like I I think it was after lunch around half an hour or an hour after lunch.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see OK, has the pain gotten worse, stayed the same, or gotten better since since yesterday?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think it's gotten, it was, it's the worst today, like especially like a few hours ago like 3 hours ago, it was much worse than the other two days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how would you describe the character or the quality of the pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's like a sharp, I would describe it as like a sharp pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and on a scale of 1 to 10, 10 being the most severe pain, what would you rate it as?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would rate it as, right now I would rate it as an 8.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has anything like this happened to you before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think it happened to me a few years back, where I had this pain and then it just kind of went away on its own. I didn't go to the Emergency Department then though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has there been anything that you've tried to make this pain any better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I tried taking just like Advil and Tylenol, but it didn't really seem to help the pain too much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any other associated symptoms such as nausea or or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've I've had some nausea over the past few days, but I haven't vomited anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so no blood in your emesis uh or no vomiting at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no like we haven't traveled anywhere recently.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, how has your energy levels been?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, energy uh when it's hurting a lot like today I've been it's been difficult to move around, I've been pretty drained from the pain but uh otherwise over the last few days it hasn't affected me too much, but today I would say my energy levels are down.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you noticed any skin changes or any rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't think so. I mean, I don't think I've noticed any kind of skin changes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about any changes to urinary habits like painful urination or the color of your urine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No no, no changes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any changes to bowel patterns such as diarrhea or changes in color of your stool?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think so. No changes that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so  notice any blood in the stool?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how has your appetite been?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's it was around the same before the pain actually started getting worse, so today I didn't really feel like eating. I did have nausea over the past few days, but my appetite I would say is the worst today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you noticed any changes to your weight recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any recent infections?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so next just to ask some questions about your past medical history, have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh so, I think the only thing is my doctor told me that I should lose some weight, but other than that no medical history.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any allergies to medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no allergies.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And are there any medications that you take on a regular basis, either prescribed or over the counter?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh not prescribed, sometimes I take like some antacids when I get heartburn. But this is just like a couple times a month after dinner, sometimes at night, but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, uh, any, um, hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just for just when I had my children, at the time of their birth, but that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been around anybody who's been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any prior surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, no prior surgeries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any family history of gallbladder disease or cardiovascular disease in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so my father died of a stroke when he was in his 60s, my mother does have gallstones.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what do you do for work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I work in at the bank as a consultant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah sometimes, maybe one or two glasses of wine every night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you feel the need to cut down on your drinking?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you ever felt annoyed by people criticizing your drinking?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you felt guilty about your drinking?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, so should I be?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uhm no, at the at this time, just wanting to gauge a sense of how you feel about your drinking levels at this time and the follow up question to that would be, have you ever felt the need to have a drink early in the morning?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no I've never drank, I don't drink in the morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you use recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no never.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And um, do, oh, and then, um, who are you living with currently at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: And so I'm living with my two children and my partner.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And can you tell me a little bit about the home situation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, the home situation is fine, like kids are doing great and my partner is very supportive. No, no issues that I can think of at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, excellent.
